title: Unfolding the line
slide_intent: Choose a form with room for multiple associations because a cultural institution needs to communicate more than one subject.
strategic_value: The zigzag can connect Whitney’s initial with ideas of movement, urban structure and a non-linear art history.
demonstration: Four black diagonal segments make a wide W on an otherwise blank white field.
practical_value: Evaluate whether a simple mark can hold a relevant conceptual relationship without requiring pictorial detail.

content_islands.name: Zigzag
content_islands.spec: Extend the four alternating diagonal strokes across the white rectangle, keeping the line thin and the background open.

reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent essay explicitly connects the zigzag with a non-linear history of art, a pulse and the museum’s urban context.
reference_purposes.Expression: The isolated black W demonstrates the identity’s thin-line vocabulary.
